headline.en: Hormuz: Iran claims tanker mine strikes, the US denies
headline.fr: Ormuz : l'Iran revendique des tankers minés, Washington dément

slides.scene: Wide view of a narrow sea strait at dawn between arid rocky mountains. Two huge oil tankers in the middle distance, a thin column of dark smoke rising far away on the horizon, a small patrol boat in the foreground cutting through the waves.

text.en: Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Revolutionary Guard says several tankers hit mines this month on routes Tehran had not authorised.
text.fr: Détroit d'Ormuz. Les Gardiens de la révolution iraniens affirment que plusieurs tankers ont heurté des mines ce mois-ci sur des routes non autorisées par Téhéran.

slides.scene: Inside a dim naval operations room: three officers in US Navy uniforms stand around a large glowing radar table showing small ship dots, one of them shaking his head, blue light on their faces.

text.en: The US military calls these claims disinformation. Maritime monitors say they found no evidence of the mine strikes.
text.fr: L'armée américaine parle de désinformation. Les centres de surveillance maritime disent n'avoir trouvé aucune preuve de ces explosions.

slides.scene: High aerial view of the strait with very few ships: wide empty water, one lone tanker escorted by a grey warship, long wakes behind them, mountains along the coast.

text.en: Ship traffic is still about 70% below pre-war levels. Before the war, some 20 million barrels of oil a day passed through here.
text.fr: Le trafic reste environ 70 % sous son niveau d'avant-guerre. Avant la guerre, quelque 20 millions de barils de pétrole y passaient chaque jour.

slides.scene: A coastal oil refinery at dusk with tall flaring chimneys, storage tanks, heavy storm clouds gathering over the sea beyond, waves breaking on the shore.

text.en: Oil prices climbed this week to about a five-month high. Efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran remain deadlocked.
text.fr: Le pétrole a grimpé cette semaine à son plus haut depuis environ cinq mois. Les efforts pour mettre fin à la guerre américano-israélienne contre l'Iran sont dans l'impasse.

headline.en: Almost all coral reefs at high risk of collapse
headline.fr: Presque tous les récifs coralliens menacés d'effondrement

slides.scene: A colourful tropical coral reef seen underwater, shoals of small fish, a diver-scientist in a wetsuit taking notes on a slate, sun rays coming through clear turquoise water.

text.en: The IUCN has published the first global assessment of coral reef ecosystems: 127 regions in more than 80 countries and territories.
text.fr: L'UICN a publié la première évaluation mondiale des écosystèmes coralliens : 127 régions dans plus de 80 pays et territoires.

slides.scene: A coral reef split down the middle: the left half alive and colourful, the right half bleached ghostly white with a few lonely fish, the same water and light on both sides.

text.en: Its verdict: 96% are critically endangered once future ocean warming is counted, with an extremely high risk of collapse by 2075.
text.fr: Son verdict : 96 % sont en danger critique si l'on tient compte du réchauffement à venir, avec un risque très élevé d'effondrement d'ici 2075.

slides.scene: A parrotfish and a large grouper swimming near pale corals, the shadow of a fishing net and a boat hull at the surface above, warm hazy water.

text.en: Heat is the main threat: it bleaches and kills corals. Overfishing of species such as parrotfish and grouper adds to the damage.
text.fr: La chaleur est la principale menace : elle blanchit et tue les coraux. La surpêche d'espèces comme le poisson-perroquet ou le mérou aggrave les dégâts.

slides.scene: A young coral fragment growing on a restoration frame underwater, small fish coming back around it, light from above, a hopeful mood.

text.en: It is not too late to give coral reefs a chance to recover.
text.fr: Il n'est pas trop tard pour donner aux récifs coralliens une chance de se rétablir.

speaker.fr: Grethel Aguilar, directrice générale de l'UICN

headline.en: Summer heat killed over 50,000 in Europe's cities
headline.fr: La chaleur de l'été a tué plus de 50 000 personnes dans les villes d'Europe

slides.scene: A sun-baked southern European street at midday: closed shutters, empty café terrace chairs, heat waves rising from the pavement, a huge sun above the rooftops.

text.en: More than 50,000 people died from heat in European cities this summer, estimate researchers from LSHTM and Imperial College London.
text.fr: Plus de 50 000 personnes sont mortes de la chaleur cet été dans les villes européennes, estiment des chercheurs de la LSHTM et de l'Imperial College de Londres.

slides.scene: A panorama of many European city skylines merged into one long horizon (domes, towers, bridges), all under the same burning sun.

text.en: It is the highest toll since 2000, nearly double 2003 or 2022. The study covers 854 urban areas in 30 countries.
text.fr: C'est le pire bilan depuis 2000, près du double de 2003 ou de 2022. L'étude porte sur 854 zones urbaines dans 30 pays.

slides.scene: Two researchers in a university office at night, looking at curves on computer screens (no numbers or letters visible), a desk fan, an open window on a hot city.

text.en: About two thirds of these deaths are attributed to human-caused climate change. The figures are model estimates, not death certificates.
text.fr: Environ deux tiers de ces décès sont attribués au changement climatique d'origine humaine. Ce sont des estimations par modèle, pas des certificats de décès.

slides.scene: A city square seen from above at dusk, people gathering in the shade of a few trees and around a public fountain, most of the square still glaring in the heat.

text.en: It is becoming increasingly clear our cities are poorly adapted to rising heat.
text.fr: Il apparaît de plus en plus clairement que nos villes sont mal adaptées à la hausse des températures.

headline.en: Helium is now a critical material in the US
headline.fr: L'hélium devient un matériau critique aux États-Unis

slides.scene: A semiconductor clean room: two technicians in white full-body suits and masks hold up a shining silicon wafer under yellow light, machines all around.

text.en: The US Energy Department has designated helium a critical material, citing its essential role in making semiconductors.
text.fr: Le département américain de l'Énergie a classé l'hélium comme matériau critique, en raison de son rôle essentiel dans la fabrication des semi-conducteurs.

slides.scene: A hospital MRI scanner room, a technician helping a patient lie down on the bed, the big round machine glowing, a smartphone and a car key on a small tray in the foreground.

text.en: Helium is also used for MRI scanners, smartphones, cars and quantum computing, and for many uses it cannot be replaced.
text.fr: L'hélium sert aussi aux IRM, aux smartphones, aux voitures et à l'informatique quantique, et pour beaucoup d'usages il est irremplaçable.

slides.scene: A gas carrier ship with round tanks stuck at anchor in a hot desert gulf, a gas plant on the shore with a damaged chimney, smoke drifting.

text.en: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz in February trapped a third of world supply in the Gulf. Iranian strikes hit a producer in Qatar in March.
text.fr: La fermeture du détroit d'Ormuz en février a bloqué un tiers de l'offre mondiale dans le Golfe. Des frappes iraniennes ont touché un producteur qatari en mars.

slides.scene: A big helium plant on the American prairie under a vast blue sky, large white spherical tanks, a worker in a hard hat giving a thumbs-up, a pickup truck nearby.

text.en: The new status opens more federal financing to producers. The United States is already the world's largest helium producer.
text.fr: Ce statut ouvre davantage de financements fédéraux aux producteurs. Les États-Unis sont déjà le premier producteur mondial d'hélium.

headline.en: Starlink slowdown hampered Ukraine's drones, WSJ says
headline.fr: Un ralentissement de Starlink a gêné les drones ukrainiens, selon le WSJ

cast.look: man in his fifties with short dark hair, black jacket over a black t-shirt
elderly man with swept-back blond hair, dark suit, long red tie

slides.scene: A swarm of small satellites forming a chain across the night sky above the curve of the Earth, city lights glowing below.

text.en: Elon Musk ordered a slowdown of a military-grade Starlink service used by Ukraine, the Wall Street Journal reported on 20 October.
text.fr: Elon Musk a ordonné le ralentissement d'un service Starlink de qualité militaire utilisé par l'Ukraine, a rapporté le Wall Street Journal le 20 octobre.

slides.scene: Two Ukrainian soldiers in a muddy autumn field crouching next to a flat satellite dish on the ground, one holding a tablet, a small quadcopter drone lifting off.

text.en: Ukraine relies on it for battlefield communications. The restrictions hampered its attack and air-defence drone missions, the paper says.
text.fr: L'Ukraine s'en sert pour ses communications sur le front. Ces restrictions ont gêné ses missions de drones d'attaque et de défense aérienne, selon le journal.

slides.scene: The SpaceX chief executive standing in a huge rocket hangar, phone to his ear, a gleaming rocket behind him, workers small in the background.

text.en: Musk said such decisions rest with the US military or the president. Donald Trump said he did not think he or Musk was responsible.
text.fr: Elon Musk assure que ces décisions relèvent de l'armée américaine ou du président. Donald Trump dit ne pas penser que lui ou Musk en soient responsables.

slides.scene: The US president sitting at a large wooden desk in an oval room, speaking on the phone, flags standing behind him without any lettering.

text.en: Trump reportedly called Musk on Wednesday to lift the restrictions. US officials said the service then worked more normally.
text.fr: Donald Trump aurait appelé Elon Musk mercredi pour lever ces restrictions. Selon des responsables américains, le service fonctionnait ensuite plus normalement.

headline.en: US widens limits on investment in rivals' military tech
headline.fr: Washington étend les limites aux investissements dans la tech militaire de ses rivaux

slides.scene: The neoclassical facade of the US Treasury building in Washington with tall columns, an official walking up the steps with a folder under his arm.

text.en: The US Treasury has proposed a rule widening limits on American investments that could boost the military power of 'countries of concern'.
text.fr: Le Trésor américain propose d'étendre les restrictions sur les investissements américains susceptibles de renforcer la puissance militaire de « pays préoccupants ».

slides.scene: A large antique globe on a desk, a hand holding back a stream of gold coins flowing across the globe toward East Asia, simple and elegant.

text.en: Those countries include China, Russia and North Korea, according to the Associated Press.
text.fr: Parmi ces pays figurent la Chine, la Russie et la Corée du Nord, selon l'agence Associated Press.

slides.scene: A montage of four small vignettes in one image: a glider streaking through the upper atmosphere with a fiery trail, rows of supercomputer cabinets, a DNA double helix, a robot hand.

text.en: The rule would cover hypersonic systems, which fly at five times the speed of sound or more, plus supercomputing, biotechnology and AI.
text.fr: La règle viserait les systèmes hypersoniques, qui volent à au moins cinq fois la vitesse du son, ainsi que les supercalculateurs, les biotechnologies et l'IA.

slides.scene: A fountain pen resting on a blank document on a polished desk, a desk lamp, a window showing the Washington Monument at dusk.

text.en: For now it is only a proposal: the rule can still change before it takes effect.
text.fr: Il ne s'agit pour l'instant que d'une proposition : la règle peut encore évoluer avant d'entrer en vigueur.

headline.en: Putin wants a final peace, not a truce
headline.fr: Poutine veut une paix définitive, pas une trêve

cast.look: man in his seventies with thinning light hair, dark suit, calm expression

slides.scene: The Russian president speaking at a long table in an ornate hall with white columns and chandeliers, a few officials listening.

text.en: Vladimir Putin said future talks on Ukraine should focus on security guarantees for both countries, Reuters reports.
text.fr: Vladimir Poutine a déclaré que de futures négociations sur l'Ukraine devraient porter sur des garanties de sécurité pour les deux pays, rapporte Reuters.

slides.scene: A large table map of Europe without any lettering, small chess pieces placed on several countries, hands of unseen negotiators hovering above.

text.en: He also wants a broader European security framework to be part of the discussions.
text.fr: Il souhaite aussi que les discussions incluent un cadre de sécurité plus large pour l'Europe.

slides.scene: Two empty chairs facing each other across a long negotiation table in a grand hall, two glasses of water, winter light through tall windows.

text.en: Any peace, he said, should come 'in its final form', not as the result of a temporary ceasefire.
text.fr: Toute paix, a-t-il dit, devrait venir « sous sa forme définitive » et non d'un cessez-le-feu temporaire.
